description: S-025 Step Log Capture and Streaming — Capture container stdout/stderr, durable host-side log files, bounded per-step buffers, batched step_log Socket.IO emission, stream completion markers, and reconnect-safe behavior without affecting running jobs on disconnect.

userStories.title: Add StepLogMessage model
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a typed step log message model in the jobs layer so the buffer API matches the existing LogMessage pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Add StepLogMessage to solar_host/jobs/models.py with fields: seq (int), timestamp (str), stream (Literal['stdout', 'stderr']), line (str), completed (bool, default false), exit_code (int | None, default None)
Export StepLogMessage from solar_host/jobs/__init__.py
Typecheck and existing tests pass

userStories.title: Create StepLogBuffer module
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a bounded per-step in-memory buffer and emit queue so step logs can be batched and flushed to Solar Control without blocking job execution.
acceptanceCriteria: Create solar_host/jobs/step_log_buffer.py keyed by (job_id, step_name) with per-step monotonic seq counter
append(job_id, step_name, step_index, stream, line) appends to bounded deque and enqueues emit entry
mark_completed(job_id, step_name, step_index, exit_code) enqueues completion entry with completed=True
get_buffer(job_id, step_name) returns list[StepLogMessage] for future debug/status endpoints
remove(job_id) purges all step buffers for a finished job
Module singleton step_log_buffer is exported
flush_step_logs() drains queue and calls broadcast_step_log_batch
step_log_flush_loop() runs on 100ms interval (FLUSH_INTERVAL_S = 0.1)
Reuse log_buffer_size (default 1000) from Settings for deque maxlen
Emit queue uses put_nowait with MAX_QUEUE_SIZE 10000; silently drops when full
Thread-safe: lock around buffer/seq mutations for executor thread pool usage
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Mirror ProcessManager deque + queue + flush pattern; separate module, not ProcessManager.

userStories.title: Add Socket.IO step_log emit helpers
userStories.description: As Solar Control, I need batched step_log events so step log lines stream in real time with the same batching pattern as instance log_batch.
acceptanceCriteria: Add send_step_log_batch(entries) to ws_client.py that emits step_log with {"entries": entries}
Add broadcast_step_log_batch(entries) mirroring send_log_batch / broadcast_log_batch
Each entry includes job_id, step_name, step_index, stream, seq, timestamp, line
Completion marker is a final entry on the same event with completed=True, exit_code set, and empty line
Emit no-ops when disconnected; does not block or crash jobs
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add demux support to DockerService.stream_logs
userStories.description: As a developer, I need optional stdout/stderr demux on Docker log streaming so Socket.IO events carry a stream field while combined log files remain unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Add demux: bool = False parameter to DockerService.stream_logs in solar_host/docker/service.py
When demux=True, call container.logs(..., demux=True) and yield (stream, line) tuples with stream 'stdout' or 'stderr'
When demux=False, preserve existing Iterator[str] behavior for backward compatibility
Add unit tests in tests/test_docker_service.py for demux stream tags
pytest tests/test_docker_service.py passes
userStories.notes: S-021 requires combined output in logs/<step_name>.log; file writer concatenates both streams in arrival order.

userStories.title: Extend JobStepExecutor for dual-write log streaming
userStories.description: As an operator, I want each job step to write durable host log files and stream lines to StepLogBuffer so logs persist locally and emit in real time.
acceptanceCriteria: Rename _stream_logs_to_file to _stream_logs with signature (job_id, step_index, step_name, container_id, log_path)
Use stream_logs(..., demux=True, tail=0) for each chunk
Write each line to log file (combined stdout+stderr, same as today)
Call step_log_buffer.append(...) for each streamed line
Call mark_completed with step exit code on normal stream end; wire from _wait_and_record when exit code is known
Update run() call site to pass job_id, step_index, step_def.name, container_id, log_path to run_in_executor
_drain_log_future waits for thread so completion markers are queued before step state is finalized
Log streaming failure does not fail the step
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Wire step log flush loop and job cleanup
userStories.description: As the host service, I need the step log flush loop started at startup and buffers cleaned up when jobs finish so memory does not leak.
acceptanceCriteria: Start step_log_flush_loop() in main.py lifespan alongside process_manager.ensure_flush_loop(loop)
Cancel and drain step log flush loop on shutdown
Call step_log_buffer.remove(job_id) in JobExecutor _finalise_job or run_job finally after terminal status
Also call remove in cleanup_loop when workspace is deleted (defensive)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add step log streaming tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I need automated tests for the buffer, executor integration, and Docker demux so regressions are caught in CI.
acceptanceCriteria: New tests/test_step_log_buffer.py: append increments seq per step; buffer respects log_buffer_size maxlen; mark_completed enqueues completion entry; remove(job_id) clears all step keys; queue overflow drops silently

Update tests/test_job_step_executor.py: mock step_log_buffer and verify append per line; verify mark_completed on success and non-zero exit; verify file writing preserved; verify streaming failure does not fail step
pytest tests/test_step_log_buffer.py tests/test_job_step_executor.py tests/test_docker_service.py passes
Lint/format per repo CI workflows passes

userStories.title: Document step log streaming in README
userStories.description: As a developer integrating with solar-host, I need README documentation for step log capture, event payloads, and reconnect behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Step Log Streaming section to host/README.md
Document data flow: container → host file + buffer → step_log → Solar Control
Document event payload shape and completion marker fields
Note JOBS_DIR/<job-id>/logs/ is durable; Socket.IO is real-time best-effort
Document reconnect behavior: emit no-ops when disconnected; jobs unaffected
